content:
Details on the future of Ivy Nile.

Fightful Select reports, “Creative sources within WWE claim that there have been plans for Ivy Nile being developed for quite a while that would see a big change for her. In addition to Ivy Nile’s creative plans discussed, @FightfulSelect has also learned that her WWE contract is coming up this fall, with no word yet on whether a new deal has been reached or offered.”

Full details are available for subscribers.

Nile has been competing on WWE Main Event, but hasn’t competed on the main roster since March.
